## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass).
- [ ] I have added type annotations to public functions and interfaces (`mypy src` passes).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing automated tests pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation where appropriate.
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, test credentials, or personal tokens are included.
